versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the multimodal-image-understanding skill.
- Enables image content understanding for text-only models by invoking external multimodal APIs.
- Automatically detects and uses user BYOK configuration for protocols (Anthropic or OpenAI).
- Provides command-line script to analyze images via prompt, supporting both local files and URLs.
- Supports environment variable references for sensitive config values to enhance security.
- Offers detailed setup, usage, and configuration instructions for flexible deployment.
